selection_reason: The empty family registry is now the direct blocker for P007, P008, P009, P010, diagonal composition, C-wave composition, and recursive positive validation. Existing shared certificate machinery is already sufficient to host a future reviewed producer, while building more generic transport would not create trustworthy family proof. The smallest honest next step is therefore to determine whether approved protected sources can define one complete, non-circular first producer and its terminal/base semantics. No implementation is safe before that source question is resolved.
required_review_scope: Identify one source-specific complete validator, if any, rather than a generic family assertion.
Lock a non-circular terminal/base case and finer-data unresolved boundary.
Lock completion, subject identity, position authority, nested proof, status, fatality, and provenance semantics.
Preserve P005 and P006 freezes unless new approved protected material or an expressly approved Brain change resolves them.

not_selected.reason: No remaining behavior satisfies all SAFE_NOW criteria.
No approved producer can truthfully issue it yet; a dormant transport contract would not directly unlock validation.
The certificate mechanism already exists, but no source-complete positive producer is known.
Protected mixed-state and required-child aggregation semantics remain silent.

next_approval_gate: Approve the bounded source-semantics review in recommended_target_design.json. Supply additional approved source material or explicitly authorize a protected Brain methodology change only if the existing protected corpus remains insufficient; Runtime must not perform that change.
